description: Get Mission Museaux's step-by-step advice for one situation: lost pet, found animal, kittens outdoors, injured animal, stray cats, mistreatment, identification (microchip, I-CAD) or adoption. Use it when someone asks what to do. Returns steps, FAQ and links, for France. Accepts French or English; replies in French, or English with langue "en".

langue.description: Response language: "fr" (French, default) or "en" (English). A request written in English is answered in English even without it.

situation.description: The situation (required): chat_perdu (lost cat), chien_perdu (lost dog), animal_trouve (found animal), chatons (kittens outdoors), animal_blesse (injured), chats_errants (stray cats), maltraitance (mistreatment), identification (microchip, I-CAD) or adoption, e.g. "chat_perdu".

name: obtenir_conseils
title: Obtenir des conseils / Get advice
